title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash Free
notes: Flagship coding and agent model on the free tier: 512k output tokens, the widest of any free route, and the only one that takes video. Tool calls are stable. It does not support temperature, and models.dev publishes no structured_output flag for it, so JSON output is requested in the prompt rather than negotiated with the API. Measured at 6-7s for a one-word reply.
